notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates NodeRoom's collaborative environment where a user uploads multiple financial spreadsheets and a task brief, triggering an AI agent that processes the data and generates a valuation comparison PDF report.

featureClarity.evidence: Clearly shows file uploads, agent execution, and the final PDF generation.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Captures the complete end-to-end flow from an empty room to the final rendered artifact.

visualDesign.evidence: Clean dark-mode interface with structured panels, though text density is high.

consistency.evidence: Perfect alignment with the files, spreadsheet, and agent trace paradigm.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic, unedited browser recording showing real-time agent execution.

legibility.evidence: Spreadsheet cells and agent logs are small but readable when maximized.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial analysts and investment banking workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Displays real agent execution steps, token costs, and processing times.

observedEvidence: Agent task execution with live trace logs
PDF artifact generation and in-app viewing

defects.observed: The file upload sequence is repetitive and takes over a minute of screen time.
defects.fix: Speed up or trim the initial file uploading phase to keep the video concise.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent analyze uploaded financial sheets and generate a comprehensive valuation comparison PDF report in real-time.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates an automated run of NodeAgent processing financial sheets and executing a task brief. While highly complete, the rapid execution speed and dense UI make it difficult to follow as a standard user-facing demo.

featureClarity.evidence: The interface shows file uploads and agent execution, but the rapid automated actions obscure the specific features being highlighted.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the entire flow from room creation and file upload to agent execution, though it lacks a clear, paused final result.

visualDesign.evidence: The dark-themed, high-density layout is professional, but the dense text and rapid updates create visual clutter.

consistency.evidence: Aligns well with the product story of collaborative sheets, files, and agent traces.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic browser capture of an E2E test, though it feels more like a test run than a curated product demo.

legibility.evidence: Most text is readable when paused, but the fast scrolling and small font size reduce real-time legibility.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial analysts and developers building agentic workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Shows real-time execution logs, including tool failures and rate limit warnings in the chat.

observedEvidence: Multi-file upload of financial spreadsheets and PDFs
Agent execution trace and logs in the right-hand panel
Interactive spreadsheet viewer displaying uploaded data

defects.observed: The execution speed is extremely fast, making it difficult for a human viewer to comprehend the agent's steps.
defects.fix: Slow down the playback or add pauses during key transitions and agent decisions.

defects.observed: Multiple 'tool_call_rate_limit_deliverable_package_failed' errors appear in the chat log.
defects.fix: Ensure the agent has sufficient rate limits or handle errors more gracefully in the UI.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent automatically ingest financial data sheets and execute a complex valuation task brief in real-time.
